name: fix_then_enhance
why: The core multi-turn property: turn 2 must build on turn 1's OUTPUT, not
re-derive it. The analyst fixes a broken playbook, then asks for an
addition without restating the playbook. A single-turn harness cannot see
this at all -- it is precisely the class where a model re-asks for context
it already has, or silently returns a FRAGMENT that would delete the
steps it omitted when the widget saves it over the open record.

steps.user: This playbook runs but never creates the record. Work out why and fix it, then give me the corrected playbook.
Good. Now also set a variable named severity to the string 'High' before the record is created. Keep everything else exactly as it is.
